from collections import Counter
def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    g=[row[:] for row in inp]
    # block color: most common non-bg color
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r if x!=bg)
    blk=max((c,n) for c,n in cnt.items())[0]
    # block bbox
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==blk]
    rs=[i for i,j in cells]; cs=[j for i,j in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=inp[i][j]
            if v==bg or v==blk: continue
            hits=[]
            if c0<=j<=c1 and r1<i: hits.append(('V',r1,i,j))   # above, shoot down
            elif c0<=j<=c1 and r0>i: hits.append(('V',r0,i,j)) # below, shoot up
            if r0<=i<=r1 and c1<j: hits.append(('H',c1,i,j))  # right
            elif r0<=i<=r1 and c0>j: hits.append(('H',c0,i,j))# left
            if len(hits)==1:
                d,h,y,x=hits[0]
                for k in range(y+1,x):
                    if inp[h][k]!=bg: break
                    g[h][k]=v
    return g

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None;bestn=0
    for c,n in cnt.items():
        if c==bg or n<4: continue
        rs=[i for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==c]
        cs=[j for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==c]
        fill=n/((max(rs)-min(rs)+1)*(max(cs)-min(cs)+1))
        if fill>bestn: bestn=fill;best=c
    blk=best
    rows=[i for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==blk]
    cols=[j for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==blk]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    g=[row[:] for row in inp]
    marks=[(i,j,inp[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]!=bg and inp[i][j]!=blk]
    for (iy,jx,v) in marks:
        hits=[]
        if c0<=jx<=c1 and (iy<r0 or iy>r1):
            hits.append(('V',r0 if iy<r0 else r1,iy,jx))
        elif r0<=iy<=r1 and (jx<c0 or jx>c1):
            hits=list()
            if jx<c0: hits.append(('H',c0,y,x))
            elif jx>c1: hits.append(('H',c1,y,x))
        if len(hits)==1:
            typ,t,y,x=hits[0]
            if typ=='V': g[t][x]=v
            else: g[y][t]=v
    return g
